Au Caire, il montre que la vision vient: In Cairo, he shows that vision comes from light entering the eye, not rays coming out of it, and proves it by experiment. According to legend, he feigned madness to escape an impossible mission from the caliph.
Elle traduit et commente les Principia d: She translated and annotated Newton's Principia, a translation that remains the reference in French. Using 's Gravesande's experiments, she showed that a body's energy depends on the square of its speed. Voltaire called her “a great man whose only fault was being a woman”.
En 1905, employé à l'Office des brevets: In 1905, a clerk at the Patent Office in Bern, he published four papers that changed physics. He didn't wear socks; to a neighbor, he explained that he had reached the age where, if told to put them on, he didn't have to.
Vers 2650 avant notre ère, il conçoit po: Around 2650 BC, he designed the step pyramid of Saqqara for the pharaoh Djoser, the first large construction in cut stone. Later, the Egyptians made him a god of medicine, and the Greeks identified him with Asclepius. Of the real man, almost nothing is known.
En 1918, elle démontre que chaque symétr: In 1918, she proved that every symmetry of nature corresponds to a conserved quantity: invariance in time gives the conservation of energy. Barred from teaching under her own name because she was a woman, she first gave her Göttingen courses under Hilbert's name. Einstein considered her a genius.
En 1956, les théoriciens Lee et Yang se: In 1956, the theorists Lee and Yang wonder whether nature distinguishes left from right. Chien-Shiung Wu sets up the experiment with cobalt-60 cooled near absolute zero: the electrons preferentially fly off to one side. Mirror symmetry is violated. Lee and Yang got the Nobel the following year; she didn't.
En 1644, il retourne un tube plein de me: In 1644, he inverts a tube full of mercury into a basin. The mercury drops to 76 centimeters and stops: it's the weight of the air that holds it, and above it, a vacuum remains, which was said to be impossible. “We live submerged at the bottom of an ocean of air.”
À 28 ans, il publie à compte d'auteur un: At 28, he self-publishes a small book on the “motive power of fire”: the efficiency of a steam engine depends on the temperature difference between hot and cold. Nobody reads it. He died of cholera at 36, and most of his papers were burned with his belongings.
